title: Exact money, DIGITS 50 and restart-safe books
summary: Accounting money is exact whole-number minor units under a 50-digit arithmetic profile. Durable books use append-only records and protected scalar encodings so large JPY amounts and numeric-looking identifiers survive JSON persistence and restart without reinterpretation.
invariants: Every Accounting Core source package and executable accounting/tax policy package must operate with at least NUMERIC DIGITS 50.
Whole-number validation must occur under the 50-digit arithmetic context before numeric datatype checks can misclassify large institutional amounts.
Amounts wider than the supported 50 significant integer digits are rejected rather than rounded.
Money is persisted as explicit canonical integer text, not as a JSON number.
Numeric-looking opaque IDs and leading-zero evidence identifiers are protected from serializer coercion.
Persistence is append-only; one store contains one accounting book for one legal entity.
Recovery rebuilds source-event indexes as well as balances so replay/conflict semantics survive restart.

provenance.claim: Exact whole minor units, DIGITS 50, protected scalar persistence, append-only records and restart-safe source identity.
